notes.title: Dawn of Insolence - Patch Notes Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Characters[/h3]
Luna Buff: Elemental damage and penetration increased.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
Blue Sword Buff: Physical damage and area size increased.
Dust Explosion Buff: No longer deals damage to the player.
Flame Breath Buff: Damage increased.
Water Breath Buff: Damage increased.
Electric Field Buff: Area size increased.
Supersonic Punch Nerf: Additional projectiles now slightly reduce damage.
Lightning Ball Nerf: Additional projectiles now slightly reduce damage.

[h3]UI Update[/h3]
Resistance Stats: Now show the damage reduction percentage for better clarity.

[h3]Status Effects Buff[/h3]
Burn, Wild Burn, and Lava effects have been buffed.

notes.title: Dawn of Insolence - Patch Notes Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In version 1.1.1, I've focused on improving the clarity and visual experience for stages:

New Stage Icons: The stage icons have been revamped to better reflect the damage type of each stage, making it easier to strategize and plan your runs.

Stage Short Descriptions: Each stage now comes with a brief description to give you a better idea of what to expect before diving in!

Thank you all for your continued support! Feel free to leave your feedback in the discussion section—it helps to make a better game.

notes.title: Dawn of Insolence - Patch Notes Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
New Features & Changes:

Passive Item Stats Generation:
Passive items now have fewer negative stats, allowing for a more positive impact on your builds.

Weapons Update:
All elemental weapons now apply their respective status effects by default!

Stages:
The total number of stages has been reduced from 12 to 9.

Shop Reroll Feature:
Added a reroll option to both the Perk Shop and Stat Buff Shop.

I hope these changes make Dawn of Insolence more enjoyable! Thank you for your support!
